sloka: तत्रायुधसहस्राणि तस्मिन्नायोधने भृशम् ।राक्षसाः कपिमुख्येषु पातयाञ्चक्रिरे तदा ।। ६.५४.५ ।।।।
transliteration: tatrāyudhasahasrāṇi tasminnāyodhane bhṛśam ।rākṣasāḥ kapimukhyeṣu pātayāñcakrire tadā ।। 6.54.5 ।।।।

translations.english: Then in that battle the Rakshasas went on hurling thousands of missiles at the chiefs of Vanaras.
